args:
set -eu
if [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}" ]; then
  exec sh "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/spool.sh" mcp
fi
base="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache"
found=
for root in "$base"/*/spooldb/0.4.28 "$base"/*/spooldb/local; do
  if [ -f "$root/.codex-plugin/plugin.json" ] && [ -f "$root/scripts/spool.sh" ]; then
    if [ -n "$found" ]; then echo 'Several SpoolDB plugin copies are installed; keep one enabled copy.' >&2; exit 1; fi
    found="$root"
  fi
done
if [ -z "$found" ]; then echo 'SpoolDB plugin cache was not found. Reinstall the SpoolDB plugin in Codex.' >&2; exit 1; fi
exec sh "$found/scripts/spool.sh" mcp
